title: When the Sigil Falls Again
author: Mara Voss
blurb: Silas Nystrom, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
